entry.title: The Silent Killer of AI Inference: Unmasking the GC Tax in High-Performance Systems
entry.summary: As Principal Software Engineer at Syrius AI, I've spent years wrestling with the invisible overheads that plague high-performance systems. In the world of AI inference, where every millisecond and every dollar counts, there's a particularly insidious antagonist: the Garbage Collection (GC) Tax. Many high-level languages rely on garbage collection to manage memory, abstracting away the complexities of allocation and deallocation. While convenient for rapid development, this abstraction comes at a steep price for low-latency, high-throughput AI inference.
